title.official: Service of originating application and evidence

operative_text.controlling:
3.9   Except as otherwise provided in rule 3.15(5), an originating
application and any affidavit and other evidence filed with the
originating application must be served on each of the other parties
10 days or more before the date scheduled for hearing the
application.

Filing and service of an Originating Notice for Judicial Review is sequential:file, then serve. And all that must occur within the 6-month limitation period.That complies with R.1.2. The requirement to serve in R.3.15(2) is substantive, not procedural and must be followed.Giving an unfiled version of the application, or a courtesy copy, is not service.And Rr.1.5(5) and 3.15(2)

expressly bar extending the limitation period. If the last day falls on a weekend, service on the next business day suffices. section of the Agency be named in bankruptcy proceedings, that does not change the law, nor

BOOK_C.division_heading: Division 2 – ACTIONS STARTED BY ORIGINATING APPLICATION

commentary.text:
As a commencement document, a respondent is given more time to respond to an originating application than an interlocutory application under Part  Regular v. Regular, [2016] A.J. No. 1042, 2016 ABQB 570 at para. 5 (Alta. Q.B.). of the Rules. Note that this timing can be abridged by the court pursuant to its powers under rule [Managing Litigation]
[Disclosure of Information] do not apply to an and [Managing Litigation] rules 4.1 , 4.2(a) [Responsibilities of parties to manage litigation]
[What the responsibility includes]
[Discontinuance of claim] and (d) and 4.36 apply, with all necessary modifications, to actions started by originating application unless the Court otherwise orders.

*[Alta. Reg. 124/2010, r. 3.10 effective November 1, 2010 (Alta. Gaz. August 14, 2010); Alta.*

Reg. 122/2012, s. 3; Alta. Reg. 23/2021, s. 2 effective March 1, 2021]
Information Note See also rule 3.12 [Application of statement of claim rules to originating applications]. Typically, an action started by originating application will not require the same kind of management, either by the parties or the Court, nor require the same kind of disclosure of records or questioning, as actions started by statement of claim. However, if management, document disclosure and questioning are required, the parties may agree or the Court may order them.
